bonus.text: Byina Rwanda was first announced in January 2024. That plan listed Latin ballroom styles and cha-cha, and promised the overall winner a furnished dance studio, rent-free for a year.
In March 2026, Indangamuco of the University of Rwanda's Huye campus won the national university traditional dance contest run by the Ministry of Youth and Arts, taking Rwf7 million.
In September 2026, Bobo Elvis became the first dancer to represent Rwanda at the Fusion Concept freestyle world finals in Paris, reaching the round of 16.
